text: MDT: the ADVANCE trigger does not carry the volume test, and my method needs it. day_vol 0.24 is a drastic shrinkage, which Elder reads as a trend pausing or expiring (C23). R8 fires (CORRECTION_REENTRY, mp_state STRONG, mp 87.0, elder_5d [6, 9, 7, 10, 10]) but is incomplete without its volume half. I stand behind h1_close_above:bar_high on H1 with timing WAIT: volume back to normal first, then the hourly close above yesterday's high while elder holds 7+. That clears me. ACT_NOW with no volume condition is not what I would act on.
